attributes.name: ypy-prefetch
attributes.description: Asks for the page a link opens before the click, and uses the response for the click. A bare attribute means `hover`. Only a link YPY navigates is prefetched, with GET, on the page's own origin and never with form data. The nearest one above the link decides; `false` turns it off for a link or a region.

values.name: hover
values.description: After the pointer rests on the link, or at once on touch.

values.name: visible
values.description: When the link comes into view.

values.name: false
values.description: Never, for this link or region.

config.name: nav
config.description: Settings of global boost and prefetch.

config.name: nav.boost
config.description: Navigate every link and form of the page with a request and a swap, with no attribute. Off when `nonce` is set. A region turns it off with `ypy-boost="false"`.

config.name: nav.prefetch
config.description: When a link the page navigates is requested ahead of the click.

config.name: nav.prefetchDelay
config.description: Milliseconds of hover before the prefetch starts.

config.name: nav.prefetchTtl
config.description: Milliseconds an unused prefetched response is kept.

config.name: nav.prefetchMax
config.description: Prefetched responses alive at once; the oldest is dropped.

config.name: nav.prefetchParallel
config.description: Prefetches in flight at once for the visibility mode.

headers.name: YPY-Purpose
headers.description: Sent with every prefetch, with `Purpose: prefetch` and `Sec-Purpose: prefetch`. A script cannot set `Sec-Purpose` (the browser drops it), so read `Purpose` or this header to tell a prefetch from a visit.
